items.original_title: US Market in for 'Pretty Painful Ride,' Pickering Says
items.rss_summary:
Kallum Pickering, chief economist at Peel Hunt, says US markets are going to have a "pretty painful ride," and the Federal Reserve will need to scale back its rate-hike expectations. "Into next year, we'll start repositioning away from the US towards the companies that can use this stuff," he tells Bloomberg Television. Pickering adds a 50 bps rate hike from the Fed in December would be a "big mistake," and instead he expects one other increase early next year.

items.original_title: Yardeni Cuts S&P 500 Target After Stock Selloff
items.rss_summary:
Wall Street strategist Ed Yardeni cut his S&P 500 Index year-end forecast for the second time in about two months in the wake of a powerful stock selloff that pushed the benchmark into a technical correction.
The president and chief investment strategist of Yardeni Research Inc. sees the index closing out 2026 at 7,500 points, down from the reduced target of 7,900 he projected in September. That would still represent a recovery of more than 8% for US stocks from where they ended on Friday.
